96: Rabbi Chiya opened and said: And the Lord said, "Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language, etc." Come and see. What is written? And as they migrated from the east [kedem]. What is [the meaning of] from kedem? From the Ancient one [Kadmon] of the world. And they found — it needed to be, "and they saw." [So] what is [the meaning of] "and they found?" Rather, they found a find there from the secrets of the wisdom of the ancient ones from the generation of the flood that had been scattered there. And it is with it that they attempted this deed that they did to rebel against the Holy One, blessed be He. So they said [secrets] with the mouth and did this deed.
